text:
Nadia R: Quick follow-up from the huddle: proposing we split headroom into guaranteed + elastic and serve elastic from a regional burst pool to cut churn.

Tom G: Guaranteed = steady reservation, elastic = short spikes. How to prevent one tenant from burning the pool?

Nadia R: Sliding-window per-tenant cap for elastic (e.g., max 24 slots per 10m) and small per-grant max (<=6). Lease lifecycle: 60s default, extend if consecutively used, cap total extension.

Priya K: Simpler rule works: deny if tenant used >X% of pool in last Y. We can iterate later to weighted fairness.

Evan M: Implementation: region-level CRD with optimistic CAS for a coarse counter. If apiserver qps is an issue, fall back to sidecar-local counters with batched sync (2s) and allow bounded oversubscribe (~2 slots).

Tom G: Oversubscribe is ok short-term but mustn't violate SLOs. Add controller that marks region "constrained" when oversubscribe > threshold and reduces grants.

Nadia R: Failure modes: operator control-plane loss => sidecars disable elastic grants (guaranteed only), emit headroom.degraded metric and Console flag.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-5254 created: regional-elastic-burst-pool + sidecar-sync.

Priya K: Fallbacks: only allow per-route fallback policies (smaller-model, truncated-seq). Trigger only after soft timeout and P95 queue latency > SLO. Log reason.

Evan M: Telemetry: region.elastic_grants, tenant.elastic_used/denied, region.oversubscribe_count, fallback.invocations, queue.wait_histogram. Billing: tag grants with grant_id and charge on use.

Tom G: Perf tests: compare CRD-only vs sidecar-batched across 5 regions, 1000 tenants, 200 qps spikes. Targets: apiserver qps and grant latency <50ms.

Nadia R: Actions: (1) I'll write RFC with config, CRD shape, failure modes, (2) Evan prototype sidecar sync + health endpoint, (3) Tom add perf tests, (4) Priya draft telemetry + billing spec. Thumbs if you support this split and sidecar approach.

Tom G: +1

Priya K: +1

Evan M: +1

Nadia R: :thumbsup: RFC incoming.
